verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for an agent workflow and skills toolkit like gstack, but the evidence pack never documents a cron, timer, or recurring-schedule feature. The closest items are one-off pipelines (/autoplan runs review skills sequentially, /ship runs a release workflow) and an auto-upgrade toggle (GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE). These are on-demand actions or adjacent controls, not user-defined recurring schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
